observations: A black camera lens is shown in three photos.
Photo 0 shows the lens barrel with 'Canon' branding.
The lens is marked 'EFS 18-55mm' and 'IMAGE STABILIZER' in photo 0.
Switches for 'AF MF' and 'STABILIZER ON OFF' are visible in photo 0.
Focal length markings 18, 24, 35, and 55 are visible on the zoom ring.
Photo 1 shows a front lens cap with 'Canon' logo.
Photo 2 shows a rear lens cap with 'Canon' logo.
The glass elements are not visible as they are covered by caps in all photos.

claims.claim: Lens are available in our shop

risks.proof: A clear photo looking through the lens elements with a bright light behind it.

risks.risk: Scratches or coating damage on front or rear glass elements
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear glass elements without the caps.

risks.risk: Failure of autofocus (AF) or Image Stabilizer (IS) motors
risks.proof: A video showing the lens successfully focusing and the stabilizer engaging on a camera body.

proof_requests: Photos of the front and rear glass elements with the caps removed.
A photo looking through the lens against a light source to check for fungus/haze.
A short video of the lens autofocusing on a camera.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the markings on the barrel in photo 0. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (scratched/fungus/manual only) until better proof is provided.
